units.source_text: 我买了一只皮箱，自然是日本造的下等货，只不过，箱子上的金属件闪闪发亮，足以唬住那些乡巴佬。

en.t: I bought a suitcase. Naturally it was an inferior Japanese-made article, but the metal fittings on it shone brightly enough to impress those country people.

units.source_text: 这只皮箱是母亲嘱咐我买的，她特意在信中写了：毕业时买一只新皮箱，把礼品都装在里面带回来。

en.t: My mother had told me to buy this suitcase; she had gone out of her way to write in her letter that when I graduated I should buy a new suitcase, put all the gifts inside it, and bring them home.

units.source_text: 我读到这句话时不由得笑了出来。

en.t: When I read that sentence, I could not help laughing.

units.source_text: 倒不是我不理解母亲的心情，只是觉得母亲这么吩咐特别滑稽。

en.t: It was not that I failed to understand how my mother felt; I simply found her instruction especially comical.

units.source_text: 正如跟先生夫妇辞行时说的那样，三天后，我就乘火车离开东京，回了故乡。

en.t: Just as I had told Sensei and his wife when I took my leave, three days later I left Tokyo by train and returned to my hometown.

units.source_text: 这年冬天以来，对于父亲的病情，先生给我讲了很多需要注意的地方。

en.t: Since that winter, Sensei had told me many things I needed to keep in mind about my father's illness.

units.source_text: 虽然最应该担心的人是我，可不知怎么，我并没有觉得多么痛苦。

en.t: Although I was the one who ought to have been most worried, somehow I did not feel especially distressed.

units.source_text: 我反而想象着父亲去世后，母亲怪可怜的。

en.t: Instead, I imagined my mother after my father's death and felt sorry for her.

units.source_text: 可见在我的心里，一定是觉得父亲已经是要走的人了。

en.t: That showed that somewhere in my heart I must already have thought of my father as someone who was about to leave this world.

units.source_text: 在给九州的哥哥的信中，我也说过父亲没有可能恢复到原来的身体了，

en.t: In a letter to my elder brother in Kyushu, I also wrote that there was no possibility of Father recovering his former health,

units.source_text: 希望他尽可能安排时间，在今年夏天赶回来见上一面。

en.t: and I hoped he would arrange his schedule as best he could and come back this summer to see him once.

units.source_text: 我还说了不少感伤的话，诸如“二老孤单地在乡下生活，想必有诸多不便吧，我们做儿子的没有尽到孝道”等等。

en.t: I also wrote many sentimental things, such as, "The two old people must have many hardships living alone in the countryside, and we sons have failed in our filial duty," and so on.

units.source_text: 其实，我也是这么想的，但是写了这封信之后的心情，跟写信的时候又有所不同。

en.t: In truth, that was how I felt, but after writing the letter my mood was different from what it had been while I was writing it.
